name: ruflo-iot-cognitum
description: IoT device lifecycle, telemetry anomaly detection, fleet management, and witness chain verification for Cognitum Seed hardware

guard.title: Write guard
guard.description: Refuse writes and commands on this plugin's own tools that hold a key, token or password.

confirmDestructive.title: Confirm destructive IoT commands
confirmDestructive.description: Refuse cognitum-iot fleet delete and device delete/remove/revoke unless the command carries --confirm or COGNITUM_IOT_CONFIRM=1.
